title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Scalar Attribute Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned RFC 9464 scalar helpers for encrypted DNS provisioning ENCDNS_IP* and ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attributes.
planned_changes:
- Add scalar payload type and address family enums.
- Add `EncryptedDnsProvisioningAttribute` for ENCDNS_IP* length, zero-length, address-family, ADN, and SvcParam policy.
- Add `EncryptedDnsProvisioningDigestInfoAttribute` for ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO request hash-algorithm list length and count policy.
- Add focused unit tests and canonical spec xrefs.
- Narrow the encrypted DNS discovery/provisioning gap to record the scalar RFC 9464 floor.
verification_plan: Run the RFC 9464 provisioning attribute tests, build the DNS package, validate core SpecTrace JSON artifacts, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, and confirm diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: IKEv2 Configuration payload byte-level encoding or parsing.
Certificate SPKI hash computation and validation.
Resolver provisioning behavior and IPsec policy integration.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned RFC 9464 scalar provisioning attribute floor that future IKEv2 integration can consume.
